title: plantago paralias var. lasiophylla
intro: Plantago paralias var. lasiophylla, commonly known as Narrow-leaved Plantain, is a plant species within the Plantaginaceae family, characterized by its narrow leaves and small white flowers. The plant is traditionally used to treat a variety of health issues, including wound healing, inflammation, and digestive problems, due to its reported health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Plantago paralias var. lasiophylla include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which may contribute to its healing and protective effects. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and polysaccharides, which are believed to be responsible for its medicinal properties.
